source: SHRM, The State of AI in HR 2026
sample: 1,722 HR professionals (completed responses), fielded 5–23 December 2025 via SHRM's Voice of Work Research Panel
sampleNote: 1,908 STARTED the survey; 1,722 completed. The analytic sample is 1,722. Both numbers are real and they are not interchangeable — using 1,908 as the sample overstates it. Five modules across three tracks carried 1,908 before the first library pass.

claims.claim: Reported AI use concentrates in recruiting 27%, HR technology management 21%, learning and development 17%, employee experience 14%
54% of organizations have implemented no AI in HR and have no plans to in 2026
51% of organizations have no formal AI use policy
52% of organizations have no direct HR involvement in overall AI strategy

cautions: 'Use cases' counts where organizations report applying AI, not what share of work is machine-made. Establishes concentration, not depth.
